flags: PRIVATE GATE FACTS: posted nightly $35 (water/electric, 20/30 or 50 A; RoverPass listing last updated 2026-11-03) - under US$50, no gateway needed. Good Sam: stored false (directory), no member discount posted. Presence: working operator site campjma.com + phone (307) 851-9854 + claimed RoverPass. Google Maps 4.7 stars / 82 reviews; RoverPass 4.7 / 48 reviews. Not on RV Life (stored rating none).

LONG-STAY (report, not read as a drop): weekly $210 and monthly $800 are posted and RoverPass says 'You can stay as long as you want'; the operator says the hookups are 'available for campers passing through or staying long-term'. Nightly share UNMEASURED: RoverPass is request-to-book with no availability calendar shown. Tests: (1) $35 passes; (2) a nightly rate is posted on its own booking channel with a phone, but every booking is 'Request to Book' / 'Booking Requires Approval' - that is RoverPass's request mechanism rather than operator wording discouraging nights, and the operator site says 'book instantly with Roverpass'; (3) no minimum stated; (4) unmeasured (no count of long-term sites anywhere; Esri imagery shows ~6-8 RVs parked); (5) no homes/lots sold. The guest volume (82 Google + 48 RoverPass reviews, Hipcamp 'Best of Wyoming' 2021/2022, Harvest Hosts listing) reads as a park mostly selling short stays, so I don't read it as long-stay in character. Reviewer may want to weigh the approval step.

AGE TAG: RoverPass 'Lifestyles' lists '55-plus' among 'Family Friendly', 'Big Rig Friendly', 'Extended Stay' - a directory tag, not an age restriction; the operator's pages state no age rule and describe families.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed (open dirt/sagebrush yard; nearest water an irrigation canal ~150 m west across the county road). Pin sits in the middle of the RV yard (Google's point is identical) - no move.
OWNERSHIP private correct (Jim Moss Arena, family-run). Phone (307) 851-9854 and website https://campjma.com/ confirmed (Google lists https://www.campjma.com/).
